Transport Modes

पोर्टेबल कन्वेयर

A mobile conveyor belt system used in warehouses, terminals, and loading docks to move bulk or packaged goods efficiently between locations, often used for temporary or flexible operations.

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

A mobile conveyor belt system used in warehouses, terminals, and loading docks to move bulk or packaged goods efficiently between locations, often used for temporary or flexible operations.

Operational example

A portable conveyor allows for rapid setup and relocation during peak warehouse activities, improving efficiency in goods handling.
